final: WITH gc AS (SELECT c.name AS name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM film_category fc JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id GROUP BY c.name), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM gc), sh AS (SELECT gc.name, gc.cnt, gc.cnt * 1.0 / tot.total AS share FROM gc CROSS JOIN tot), avgsh AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM sh), kept AS (SELECT sh.name, sh.cnt, sh.share, avgsh.avg_share FROM sh CROSS JOIN avgsh WHERE sh.share > avgsh.avg_share) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_genre_count, AVG(share) AS avg_genre_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_share_minus_avg FROM kept
